full_article:
KATHMANDU: Economic Digest presents a brief yet comprehensive roundup of major business developments in Nepal, delivered in clear and accessible summaries.

Nepal’s economy displayed mixed signals, with positive movement in financial markets alongside persistent structural challenges in trade, production and social security. The Nepal Stock Exchange showed renewed investor activity as the NEPSE index and turnover increased, although sectoral performance remained uneven.

Gold and silver prices declined, reflecting short-term changes in domestic and international market conditions. Meanwhile, Nepal continued to face a large import burden, highlighted by diesel and smartphone imports, indicating strong dependence on foreign goods and pressure on the trade balance, particularly with India and China.

The government and regulatory bodies continued efforts to strengthen financial governance through measures such as mandatory national ID verification for digital wallets, increased action against money laundering and restrictions on illegal digital platforms. Social protection systems also remain an area of concern, as most migrant workers registered with the Social Security Fund are not making regular contributions, limiting the effectiveness of the scheme.

Provincial economic performance showed varied trends, with Sudurpashchim and Dang exceeding or maintaining significant revenue collections, while Madhesh focused on improving traffic management and revenue generation. In agriculture, declining food grain production and shrinking cultivated land in Jhapa highlight growing concerns over rural productivity and land use. Infrastructure and development initiatives, such as the Harichowk-Yamdi road expansion and Gandaki’s agricultural loan subsidies, reflect attempts to boost connectivity, employment and local production.

Overall, the developments indicate gradual institutional reforms and investment efforts, but Nepal continues to face challenges related to trade dependency, economic sustainability, agricultural decline and effective implementation of public policies.

Nepal’s public debt nears Rs 3 trillion

Nepal’s total public debt has climbed to nearly Rs 3 trillion, reaching Rs 2.97 trillion by the end of the last fiscal year 2025/26, according to the latest monthly report released by the Public Debt Management Office. The report shows that the country’s total public debt stood at Rs 2.67 trillion at the beginning of the fiscal year. Over the course of the year, the debt increased by around Rs 300.85 billion, including losses resulting from exchange rate fluctuations. The total public debt now amounts to 45.07 percent of Nepal’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Of the total debt, 53.77 percent is external debt, while 46.23 percent is domestic debt. By the end of the fiscal year, external debt had reached Rs 1.60 trillion, while domestic debt stood at Rs 1.38 trillion.

NEPSE gains 7.90 points as turnover reaches Rs 6.26 billion

The Nepal Stock Exchange (NEPSE) index increased by 7.90 points on Friday to close at 2,734.63, while daily turnover rose to Rs 6.26 billion from Rs 4.67 billion the previous day. Share prices of 143 companies increased, 118 declined and 15 remained unchanged. The Banking sector recorded the highest gain, followed by Development Banks and Hotels and Tourism, while Trading, Manufacturing and Processing, Hydropower, Finance and Others posted losses. Ridi Power Company, NRN Infrastructure and Development, Kumari Bank, Ankhukhola Jalvidhyut Company and Reliance Spinning Mills were among the most actively traded companies. Everest Color Company was the top gainer of the day, with its share price rising 15 percent, while Corporate Development Bank recorded the largest decline, dropping 7.38 percent.

Nepal’s foreign trade rises by 15.88 percent, diesel tops imports and soybean oil leads exports

Nepal’s foreign trade increased by 15.88 percent in the last fiscal year 2025/26 compared to the previous fiscal year, according to data from the Department of Customs. During the review period, Nepal imported goods worth Rs 2.09 trillion, marking a 16.20 percent increase compared to the previous fiscal year. Similarly, exports rose to Rs 315.29 billion, an increase of 13.81 percent compared to the previous year. The data shows that petroleum products continued to dominate Nepal’s import basket, with diesel recording the highest import value. Meanwhile, processed soybean oil and raw materials emerged as the country’s top export item.

Gold falls to Rs 285,500 per tola, silver to Rs 4,350

Gold and silver prices declined in the domestic market on Friday. According to the Federation of Nepal Gold and Silver Dealers’ Association, gold prices fell by Rs 5,800 per tola (11.66 grams) to Rs 285,500. Gold was traded at Rs 291,300 per tola on Thursday. Similarly, silver prices dropped by Rs 155 per tola to Rs 4,350, compared to Rs 4,505 per tola on Thursday.

NRB requires national ID verification for digital wallet users

The Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) has directed all payment service providers to verify digital wallet users against national identity card records under its unified directives. Wallet operators must collect self-declarations from users regarding their national identity cards and update electronic records by October 17, 2026. Users who do not have national identity cards must receive monthly reminders through mobile applications to complete their Know Your Customer (KYC) updates. Nepali citizens living abroad and individuals unable to independently manage their affairs may open digital wallets using alternative documents, provided their details are updated within 35 days of returning to Nepal.

Government maintains Rs 2.5 million deposit rule for educational consultancies

Minister for Education and Sports Sasmit Pokharel has said the government will not withdraw the mandatory Rs 2.5 million deposit requirement imposed on educational consultancy operators. Speaking at Singha Durbar, Minister Pokharel said the provision under the Educational Consultancy, Language Teaching, and Preparation Class Operation and Management Regulation 2026 would remain in place. He also urged educational institutions and government offices to fully implement the two-day weekly weekend holiday system and said discussions with Dr Govinda KC are continuing.

Diesel imports surpass Rs 172 billion

Nepal imported diesel worth Rs 172.42 billion in fiscal year 2025/26, making it the country’s largest imported petroleum product, according to the Department of Customs. Other major imports included crude soybean oil worth Rs 132.76 billion, petrol worth Rs 77.26 billion, liquefied petroleum gas worth Rs 60.28 billion and semi-processed iron worth Rs 58.52 billion. Soybean oil was the leading export item, valued at Rs 128.74 billion. The country recorded trade deficits of Rs 951.95 billion with India and Rs 423.35 billion with China.

Smartphone imports reach Rs 48 billion in FY 2025/26

Nepal imported 2,267,419 smartphones worth Rs 48.693 billion in fiscal year 2025/26, marking a 37 percent increase compared to the previous year, according to the Department of Customs. The imports generated Rs 9.082 billion in government revenue. China accounted for the largest share, supplying 1,889,664 smartphones worth Rs 36.792 billion, followed by India with 364,842 units valued at Rs 10.99 billion. The United States supplied 1,789 units.

SSF says majority of overseas workers do not make regular contributions

Around 92 percent of migrant workers registered with the Social Security Fund (SSF) do not make regular monthly contributions after obtaining labour permits, resulting in more than Rs 5 billion in missed monthly deposits, according to SSF statistics. Of the 2.332 million overseas workers registered with the fund, only around 8 percent continue regular contributions. Their total deposits amount to Rs 651 million, significantly lower than the Rs 116.469 billion contributed by 716,000 formal sector workers. The fund said many migrant workers treat registration as a requirement for labour approval rather than a long-term social security arrangement.

Health Insurance Board releases Rs 2 billion in claim payments

The Health Insurance Board has released Rs 2.048 billion for approved health insurance claims up to mid-January 2026, transferring the payments directly to the bank accounts of healthcare institutions providing insured services. The payment covers claims up to January 14, 2026, for fiscal year 2025/26. The board said it remains committed to regular, transparent and phased settlement of claims to partner hospitals and health facilities nationwide.

Sudurpashchim exceeds internal revenue target, collects Rs 1.898 billion

Sudurpashchim Province collected Rs 1.898 billion in internal revenue in fiscal year 2025/26, exceeding its target of Rs 1.65 billion by Rs 248 million. The Provincial Treasury Controller Office attributed the increase largely to insurance payments received for government vehicles damaged during the Gen Z protest on September 9, 2025. Despite exceeding its target, the province’s annual internal revenue collection has remained below Rs 2 billion for consecutive years.

Madhesh collects nearly Rs 130 million in traffic revenue

Madhesh Province collected Rs 111.5 million in revenue from 110,755 traffic rule violations during fiscal year 2025/26. The province also collected Rs 15.4 million in fines from 848 overloaded vehicles penalized through transport offices. Officials said revenue collection declined due to a two-month disruption caused by the Gen Z protest and improved compliance among road users. However, traffic accidents increased to 11,416 cases across eight districts, while fatalities fell by 30 to 534. Motorcycles accounted for the highest number of violations and accidents, with 7,851 cases. Authorities conducted 26,883 awareness programmes involving 1,424,844 participants.

Harichowk-Yamdi road upgraded into four-lane highway at Rs 480 million

The Harichowk-Yamdi section of the road in Pokhara has been upgraded into a four-lane highway following repeated demands from local residents. The 2.2-kilometre section, part of the Bhupi Sherchan Highway and Mid-Hill Highway, gained attention after locals staged a protest by planting paddy on the muddy road on National Paddy Day on June 29, 2024. Motidan Construction Sewa completed the project under a contract awarded on July 30, 2022, at a cost of Rs 480 million. The project was completed after three deadline extensions, with the final deadline ending in mid-May 2026.

Gandaki allocates Rs 20 million for youth agricultural loan subsidies

Gandaki Province has allocated Rs 20 million under its Return to Village programme to provide interest subsidies on agricultural loans for youths returning from foreign employment or urban areas to start farming businesses. The Ministry of Agriculture, Land Management and Cooperatives also announced Rs 10 million for agricultural ambulance support and Rs 26 million for organic fertilizer subsidies and production incentives. The initiatives aim to promote local employment and increase agricultural production in the province.

Nepal Oil Corporation says no LPG shortage in Surkhet

The Surkhet branch of Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC) has clarified that there is no shortage of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in Birendranagar, attributing recent supply issues to panic buying and hoarding. Branch chief Dipak Kumar Ghimire said regular LPG imports from India are continuing and the corporation has introduced a “one person, one cylinder” distribution system. Under the arrangement, 2,922 cylinders will be distributed through authorized dealers at Rs 2,060 per cylinder. The corporation has urged consumers not to stockpile LPG and requested them to report cases of overcharging.

Jhapa sees decline in food grain production and cultivated area

Jhapa produced 761,433 metric tons of food grains in fiscal year 2025/26, down from 852,208.25 metric tons in the previous year, as the area under cultivation continued to shrink. According to the Agriculture Knowledge Centre, food crops were cultivated on 130,386 hectares during the year, compared to 145,326.06 hectares in 2024/25, a reduction of nearly 14,940 hectares. The district produced 377,534.35 metric tons of monsoon paddy, 89,655.30 metric tons of spring paddy, and 283,187.88 metric tons of maize, along with millet, buckwheat, wheat and barley. The centre said both cultivated land and food grain output have been declining in recent years.

Dang district collects Rs 4.99 billion in revenue

Dang district collected Rs 4.998 billion in revenue during fiscal year 2025/26, a decline of Rs 550.8 million compared to the previous year. According to the District Treasury Controller Office, 42 federal government offices contributed Rs 4.051 billion to the total collection. The Inland Revenue Office, Dang, recorded the highest contribution with Rs 3.693 billion. Similarly, 22 provincial government offices collected Rs 946.8 million, with transport management offices contributing the largest share of Rs 560.1 million.

NTA blocks over 200,000 illegal betting and scam-related apps

The Nepal Telecommunications Authority (NTA) has blocked more than 223,000 websites and mobile applications linked to illegal online betting and financial scams. The action was taken following government directives and increased concerns over digital fraud during the FIFA World Cup. The authority formed a dedicated task force with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) to identify and block illegal URLs in real time using threat intelligence tools. Officials said operators continue to create new domains to avoid restrictions, but monitoring, URL tracking and public reporting mechanisms remain active to disrupt such networks.

NRB to begin exchange of INR 200 and INR 500 notes

Nepal Rastra Bank (NRB) has decided to facilitate the exchange of Indian currency notes of INR 200 and INR 500 following discussions with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). The decision comes after increased use of these denominations, particularly following the government’s decision to allow individuals to carry up to INR 25,000 in INR 200 and INR 500 notes from mid-November. Under existing regulations, Nepali and Indian citizens can carry, exchange or transport up to INR 25,000 in these banknotes issued after November 9, 2016. NRB said restrictions on old INR 1,000 and INR 2,000 notes remain unchanged.

Department files seven money laundering cases in FY 2025/26

The Department of Money Laundering Investigation filed seven prosecution cases involving 121 defendants and sought recovery of approximately Rs 118.05 billion during fiscal year 2025/26. The department investigates financial crimes including revenue leakage, customs evasion and illegal accumulation of wealth through specialized investigation branches and legal, administrative and coordination units. Officials said investigative procedures and screening operations were intensified during the year to control financial crimes.

US provides USD 1 million health equipment to Nepal

The United States has handed over health equipment worth USD 1 million, along with a refrigerated freezer van, to support maternal, newborn and child health services and Nepal’s immunization programme. US Chargé d’Affaires ad interim Scott Urbom handed over the equipment to government officials at the Department of Health Services in Teku on Friday, according to the US Embassy. The freezer van will transport vaccines at minus 20 degrees Celsius from the Central Vaccine Store to all seven provinces. The health equipment will be distributed to provincial, district and tertiary-level hospitals.

Guthi Corporation begins search for encroached land in Janakpur

The Guthi Corporation has launched investigations to identify and reclaim land belonging to religious trusts that has allegedly been encroached in Janakpur. A seven-day public notice was issued in Janakpurdham, instructing people occupying trust land illegally to remove unauthorized structures. According to Janakpurdham branch chief Kishor Kumar Jha, around 148,000 to 169,000 square metres of trust land have been encroached. The affected areas include five ponds that have disappeared and built-up areas around Ratna Sagar and Belakutti.

काठमांडू : इकोनॉमिक डाइजेस्ट नेपाल केरऽ प्रमुख व्यापारिक विकास केरऽ संक्षिप्त लेकिन व्यापक गोल-मटोल प्रस्तुत करै छै, जेकरा स्पष्ट आरू सुलभ सारांश म॑ देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

नेपाल केरऽ अर्थव्यवस्था म॑ मिश्रित संकेत देखलऽ गेलै, जेकरा म॑ व्यापार, उत्पादन आरू सामाजिक सुरक्षा म॑ लगातार संरचनात्मक चुनौती के साथ-साथ वित्तीय बाजारऽ म॑ सकारात्मक आंदोलन भी देखलऽ गेलै । नेपाल स्टॉक एक्सचेंजमे नेप्से सूचकांक आ कारोबार बढलासँ निवेशक सक्रियता नवीन देखल गेल, यद्यपि क्षेत्रीय प्रदर्शन असमान रहल ।

सोना आरू चांदी केरऽ दाम म॑ गिरावट ऐलै, जे घरेलू आरू अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार केरऽ हालत म॑ अल्पकालिक बदलाव क॑ दर्शाबै छै । एम्हर नेपाल मे आयातक पैघ बोझ जारी रहल, जकरा डीजल आ स्मार्टफोन आयात सँ उजागर भेल अछि, जे विदेशी वस्तु पर मजबूत निर्भरता आ व्यापार संतुलन पर दबाव के संकेत दैत अछि, खास क भारत आ चीन के संग।

सरकार आरू नियामक निकाय न॑ डिजिटल बटुआ लेली अनिवार्य राष्ट्रीय आईडी सत्यापन, मनी लांड्रिंग के खिलाफ बढ़लऽ कार्रवाई आरू अवैध डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म प॑ प्रतिबंध जैसनऽ उपाय के माध्यम स॑ वित्तीय शासन क॑ मजबूत करै के प्रयास जारी रखलकै । सामाजिक सुरक्षा प्रणाली सेहो चिंता कें क्षेत्र बनल छै, कियाकि सामाजिक सुरक्षा कोष मे पंजीकृत अधिकांश प्रवासी श्रमिक नियमित रूप सं योगदान नहि द रहल छै, जे योजना कें प्रभावशीलता कें सीमित कयर रहल छै.

प्रांतीय आर्थिक प्रदर्शन मे विभिन्न रुझान देखल गेल, जाहि मे सुदुरपश्चिम आ डांग मे महत्वपूर्ण राजस्व संग्रह स बेसी या बरकरार रहल, जखन कि मधेश यातायात प्रबंधन आ राजस्व उत्पादन मे सुधार पर ध्यान केंद्रित केलक। कृषि मे झापा मे खाद्य अनाज उत्पादन मे कमी आ खेती वाला जमीन सिकुड़ब ग्रामीण उत्पादकता आ भूमि उपयोग पर बढ़ैत चिंता कें उजागर करएयत छै. बुनियादी ढांचा आरू विकास पहल, जेना कि हरिचोक-यमडी सड़क विस्तार आरू गंडकी क कृषि ऋण सब्सिडी, कनेक्टिविटी, रोजगार आरू स्थानीय उत्पादन क बढ़ावा दै के कोशिश क दर्शाबै छै.

पोखरा के सड़क के हरिचोक-यमडी खंड के स्थानीय निवासी के बेर-बेर मांग के बाद फोर लेन हाईवे मे अपग्रेड क देल गेल अछि. भूपी शेरचन राजमार्ग आ मिड-हिल राजमार्ग के हिस्सा बनल 2.2 किलोमीटर के ई हिस्सा 29 जून 2024 के राष्ट्रीय धान दिवस पर कीचड़ वाला सड़क पर धान लगा क स्थानीय लोक के विरोध प्रदर्शन के बाद ध्यान आकर्षित केलक।मोतिदान निर्माण सेवा 30 जुलाई 2022 के 48 करोड़ रुपया के लागत स देल गेल ठेका के तहत ई परियोजना पूरा केलक। ई परियोजना तीन समय सीमा बढ़ाबै के बाद पूरा होय गेलै, जेकरऽ अंतिम समय सीमा मई २०२६ के मध्य म॑ समाप्त होय गेलै ।

गण्डकी युवा कृषि ऋण अनुदान के लेल दू करोड़ रुपैया आवंटित करैत अछि

गण्डकी प्रदेश अपन गाम वापसी कार्यक्रम के तहत विदेशी रोजगार या शहरी क्षेत्र स वापस आबय वाला युवा के खेती के व्यवसाय शुरू करय लेल कृषि ऋण पर ब्याज सब्सिडी देबय लेल दू करोड़ रुपया आवंटित केलक अछि. कृषि, भूमि प्रबंधन आ सहकारी मन्त्रालय कृषि एम्बुलेन्स सहयोगके लेल एक करोड़ आ जैविक खाद अनुदान आ उत्पादन प्रोत्साहनके लेल २.६ लाख रुपैयाँके घोषणा सेहो केलक अछि । एहि पहल क उद्देश्य स्थानीय रोजगार कए बढ़ावा देब आ प्रांत मे कृषि उत्पादन मे वृद्धि करब अछि।

नेपाल तेल निगम सुर्खेतमे एलपीजीक कमी नहि रहल कहैत अछि

नेपाल तेल निगम के सुर्खेत शाखा बीरेन्द्रनगर मे तरल पेट्रोलियम गैस (एलपीजी) के कमी नहि रहल स्पष्ट केलक अछि, हाल के आपूर्ति के मुद्दा के कारण घबराहट खरीद आ जमाखोरी के कारण बताओल गेल अछि। शाखा प्रमुख दिपक कुमार घिमिरे नँ कहलकै कि भारत सँ नियमित रूप सँ एलपीजी आयात जारी छै आरू निगम नँ “एक व्यक्ति, एक सिलेंडर” वितरण प्रणाली शुरू करलकै । एहि व्यवस्था क तहत अधिकृत डीलर क माध्यम स 2922 सिलेंडर क वितरण 2060 टका प्रति सिलेंडर कैल जाएत। निगम उपभोक्ता स एलपीजी क भंडार नहि लगेबाक आग्रह केलक अछि आ ओवरचार्जिंग क मामला रिपोर्ट करबाक आग्रह केलक अछि।

झापा मे खाद्यान्न उत्पादन आ खेती योग्य क्षेत्र मे गिरावट देखल जा रहल अछि

झापा मे वित्तीय वर्ष 2025/26 मे 761,433 मीट्रिक टन खाद्य अनाज क उत्पादन भेल, जे पिछला साल 852,208.25 मीट्रिक टन छल, किया कि खेती क क्षेत्र मे लगातार कमी आयल। कृषि ज्ञान केंद्र क अनुसार एहि साल 130,386 हेक्टेयर मे खाद्य फसल क खेती भेल, जखन कि 2024/25 मे 145,326.06 हेक्टेयर मे खाद्य फसल क खेती भेल, जे लगभग 14,940 हेक्टेयर क कमी अछि। जिला मे बाजरा, एक प्रकार क अनाज, गहूम आ जौ क संग 377,534.35 मीट्रिक टन मानसून धान, 89,655.30 मीट्रिक टन वसंत धान, आ 283,187.88 मीट्रिक टन मक्का क उत्पादन भेल। केंद्र के कहनाय अछि जे हाल के साल मे खेती वाला जमीन आओर खाद्य अनाज दुनु के उत्पादन मे गिरावट आबि रहल अछि.

डांग जिला मे 4.99 अरब टका क राजस्व वसूली होइत अछि

वित्तीय वर्ष 2025/26 के दौरान दांग जिला के 4.998 अरब रुपया के राजस्व संकलन भेल जे पिछला साल के मुकाबले 55 करोड़ 80 लाख रुपया के गिरावट अछि। जिल्ला कोष नियंत्रक कार्यालयके अनुसार कुल संग्रहमे ४२ संघीय सरकार कार्यालय ४.०५१ अरब रुपैयाँ योगदान देलक । अंतर्देशीय राजस्व कार्यालय डांग मे सबस बेसी योगदान 3.693 अरब टका दर्ज कैल गेल अछि। तहिना 22 प्रांतीय सरकारी कार्यालय मे 94.68 करोड़ टका संकलन भेल, जाहि मे परिवहन प्रबंधन कार्यालय सबस बेसी 56 करोड़ 10 लाख टका क योगदान देलक अछि।

एनटीए दू लाख सं बेसि अवैध सट्टेबाजी आ घोटाला सं जुड़ल ऐप के ब्लॉक क दैत अछि

नेपाल दूरसंचार प्राधिकरण अवैध ऑनलाइन सट्टेबाजी आ वित्तीय घोटाला सँ जुड़ल २ लाख २३ हजार सँ बेसी वेबसाइट आ मोबाइल एप्लीकेशन अवरुद्ध केने अछि । ई कार्रवाई सरकारी निर्देश आरू फीफा विश्व कप के दौरान डिजिटल धोखाधड़ी के चिंता बढ़ला के बाद करलौ गेलौ छै । प्राधिकरण न॑ इंटरनेट सेवा प्रदाता (आईएसपी) के साथ एगो समर्पित टास्क फोर्स के गठन करलकै जेकरा स॑ खतरा खुफिया उपकरण के उपयोग करी क॑ वास्तविक समय म॑ अवैध यूआरएल के पहचान आरू ब्लॉक करलऽ जाय । अधिकारी नँ कहलकै कि ऑपरेटर प्रतिबंध स॑ बचै लेली नया डोमेन बनाबै के काम जारी छै, लेकिन ऐसनऽ नेटवर्क क॑ बाधित करै लेली निगरानी, ​​यूआरएल ट्रैकिंग आरू सार्वजनिक रिपोर्टिंग तंत्र सक्रिय छै ।

एनआरबी 200 आ 500 रुपया के नोट के आदान-प्रदान शुरू करत

नेपाल राष्ट्र बैंक भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) के साथ चर्चा के बाद 200 आ 500 रुपया के भारतीय मुद्रा के नोट के आदान-प्रदान के सुविधा देबय के फैसला केलक अछि। ई फैसला ई संप्रदायऽ के बढ़लऽ उपयोग के बाद आबी गेलऽ छै, खास करी क॑ सरकार केरऽ फैसला के बाद कि नवंबर के मध्य स॑ व्यक्ति क॑ 200 रुपया आरू 500 रुपया के नोट ले जाय के अनुमति मिलतै । मौजूदा नियमावली के तहत नेपाली आ भारतीय नागरिक 9 नवम्बर 2016 के बाद जारी एहि नोट मे 25 हजार रुपया तक के वाहक, आदान-प्रदान या परिवहन क सकैत छथि। एनआरबी के कहनाय अछि जे पुरान 1000 आओर 2000 रुपया के नोट पर रोक अपरिवर्तित अछि.

विभाग वित्तीय वर्ष 2025/26 मे सातटा मनी लांड्रिंग मामला दर्ज केलक

मनी लांड्रिंग जांच विभाग न॑ 121 प्रतिवादी स॑ जुड़लऽ सात अभियोजन मामला दर्ज करलकै आरू वित्तीय वर्ष 2025/26 के दौरान लगभग 118.05 अरब रुपया के वसूली के मांग करलकै । विभाग विशेष जांच शाखा आ कानूनी, प्रशासनिक आ समन्वय इकाइ के माध्यम सं राजस्व रिसाव, सीमा शुल्क चोरी आ अवैध रूप सं धन संचय सहित वित्तीय अपराध के जांच करैत अछि. अधिकारी नँ कहलकै कि वित्तीय अपराध प नियंत्रण लेली साल भर मँ जांच प्रक्रिया आरू जांच अभियान क तेज करलौ गेलौ छै ।

अमेरिका नेपाल के 10 लाख डॉलर के स्वास्थ्य उपकरण उपलब्ध कराबैत अछि

अमेरिका मातृ, नवजात आ बाल स्वास्थ्य सेवा आ नेपाल के टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम के सहायता के लेल 10 लाख डॉलर के स्वास्थ्य उपकरण के संग फ्रिज फ्रीजर वैन सेहो सौंपलक अछि. अमेरिकी दूतावास के अनुसार, अमेरिकी चार्ज डी’अफेयर्स एड इंटरिम स्कॉट उर्बम न॑ शुक्रवार क॑ टेकू म॑ स्वास्थ्य सेवा विभाग म॑ सरकारी अधिकारियऽ क॑ ई उपकरण सौंपलकै । फ्रीजर वैन सेंट्रल वैक्सीन स्टोर स माइनस 20 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर टीका कए सातों प्रांत तक पहुंचाओत। स्वास्थ्य उपकरण प्रांतीय, जिला आ तृतीयक स्तरीय अस्पताल मे वितरित कैल जाएत।

गुठी निगम जनकपुर मे अतिक्रमण भूमि के खोज शुरु

गुठी निगम जनकपुरमे कथित अतिक्रमण भेल धार्मिक ट्रस्टके भूमिके पहिचान आ पुनर्प्राप्तिके लेल अनुसन्धान शुरु केने अछि । जनकपुरधाम मे सात दिनक सार्वजनिक सूचना जारी कएल गेल जाहि मे अवैध रूप सँ ट्रस्ट जमीन पर कब्जा करय वाला लोक के अनधिकृत संरचना हटाबय के निर्देश देल गेल अछि. जनकपुरधाम शाखा प्रमुख किशोर कुमार झाके अनुसार लगभग १ लाख ४८ सँ १ लाख ६९ हजार वर्ग मीटर ट्रस्ट भूमि अतिक्रमण भेल अछि । प्रभावित क्षेत्र मे रत्न सागर आ बेलाकुट्टी के आसपास पांचटा पोखरि जे गायब भ गेल अछि आ बनल इलाका शामिल अछि।

title: How Nepali para-swimmers are turning tragic negligence into a shot at Asian Para Games glory - The Kathmandu Post
description: How Nepali para-swimmers are turning tragic negligence into a shot at Asian Para Games glory  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
What are the basics of swimming? Hands and legs maybe.

But when Jenisha Kadayat, Harka Man Gharti and Member Singi Syangba stood at the edge of the pool at the Refresh Recreation Centre in Bauddha on Friday morning, they lacked what most would consider the bare basics.

Kadayat warmed up from her wheelchair, her body immobile below the waist due to a spinal cord injury. Gharti, who has no arms, stretched his legs and torso, while Syangba—his left leg amputated below the knee—hopped on one foot to maintain his balance as he went through his warm-up routine.

As the trio waited for coach Subha Shrestha’s whistle, Kadayat was already afloat in the lane since she could not stand, while able-bodied swimmers nearby and gym-goers on the floor above, who saw the trio for the first time, watched in amazement: How can they swim?

But the moment the whistle blew for a 100-metre swim, their doubts evaporated. Gharti and Syangba sliced into the water with sharp dives, while Kadayat propelled herself forward, her stroke clean and powerful. They weren’t just swimming; they were executing laps like professionals along the 25-metre-long pool.

The trio was training for the fifth edition of the Asian Para Games, scheduled for October in Japan.

“We have four swimmers preparing to represent the country,” said Saroj Shrestha, president of the Nepal Para Swimming Association. “Srijana Sarki is our fourth, though she missed today’s session.”

The squad has been training at the Boudha facility for about five months—a location chosen largely out of necessity.

“Finding an accessible pool for para-athletes is exceptionally hard,” Shrestha explained. “The swimming complex in Satdobato is simply too far for them to commute regularly. We are deeply grateful to this centre for giving us pool access at a heavy discount.”

Except on weekends, their one-hour training session kicks off precisely at 7:30am.

Getting there is quite a for these swimmers. Kadayat, who lives in a hostel in Jorpati, arrives on a scooter retrofitted with auxiliary support wheels to navigate the Kathmandu traffic. Gharti and Syangba, who walks with a prosthetic leg, arrive on foot, as they live within a ten-minute walk from the venue.

But their journey to this pool started much further away—and in ways none could have anticipated.

Injured by someone else’s negligence

Kadayat was riding her bicycle home in Kailali’s Gauriganga Municipality, her mind drifting through ordinary thoughts. Then, in a split second, a tree crashed down on her, altering her life forever.

“It was on November 2, 2013,” recalls Kadayat, now 26. The date is etched in her memory. “Some people were chopping down a tree. There were no warning signs to alert passersby, and no one standing by to tell people to stop. The tree fell on top of me. The next thing I knew was that I had lost all movement in the lower half of my body from a spinal cord injury.”

A couple of years later, around the time of the devastating April 2015 earthquake, Gharti’s life took another tragic turn.

“I was just a kid back then,” recalls the 21-year-old native of Baglung. “We used to play and herd cattle near an under-construction hydropower site. One day I grabbed an insulator—something I had touched many times before—without knowing the power had been switched on. I was severely electrocuted. There was no fencing, no warning signs, nothing to keep us away.”

Syangba, on the other hand, was working in the transport sector at the Kerung border crossing between Nepal and China in Rasuwa district. The year was 2017.

“I was standing beside our truck on the side of the road when another truck hit me,” Syangba shared. “My left leg was crushed so badly that it had to be amputated below the knee. Because the accident happened right in the border zone, no authorities on either side ever filed a case or initiated legal proceedings.”

Without any legal accountability, none of the three received compensation from those responsible for their accidents. Saroj Shrestha, president of the Nepal Para Swimming Association, noted that their journey from injury to elite training was borne entirely out of personal endurance.

“None of the trio received any financial support from the authorities and covered their treatment on their own,” Saroj said. “They lost their abilities, but have dedicated themselves to a bigger goal. We are glad they took up a sport and decided to make their name as they still have a lot of fire in them.”

हेलबाक मूल बात की अछि ? हाथ-पैर शायद।

लेकिन शुक्रवार क॑ सुबह जब॑ जेनीशा कदायत, हरका मन घरती आरू सदस्य सिंगी स्यांगबा बौद्ध केरऽ रिफ्रेश रिक्रिएशन सेंटर म॑ पूल के किनारे खड़ा होय गेलै त॑ ओकरा सब म॑ वू कमी छेलै जेकरा अधिकांश लोग नंगे मूल बात मानतै ।

रीढ़ के हड्डी के चोट के कारण कमर स नीचा देह स्थिर भ क कदायत व्हीलचेयर स गरम भ गेल। घर्ती, जेकरऽ हाथ नै छै, अपनऽ टांग आरू धड़ तानलकै, जबकि स्यांगबा- ओकरऽ बायां टांग ठेहुना के नीचें काटलऽ गेलऽ छेलै-अपनऽ वार्म-अप रूटीन सें गुजरतें-चलतें संतुलन बनाबै लेली एक पैर पर कूदी गेलै ।

जखन तिकड़ी कोच सुभा श्रेष्ठ के सीटी के इंतजार में छल, कदयात पहिने सं लेन में तैरैत छल, कियाक त ओ ठाढ़ नहि भ सकैत छल, जखन कि पास में सक्षम तैराक आ ऊपर के फर्श पर जिम-गोर, जे पहिल बेर तिकड़ी के देखने छल, आश्चर्यचकित भ क देखैत छल: कोना हेलत?

मुदा जहिया 100 मीटर हेलबाक लेल सीटी बाजल तहिया हुनका लोकनिक शंका वाष्पित भ गेलनि। घरती आ स्यांगबा तेज गोता लगा क' पानि मे टुकड़ा-टुकड़ा क' लेलक, जखन कि कदायत अपना केँ आगू बढ़ा लेलक, ओकर स्ट्रोक साफ आ शक्तिशाली। ओ सभ खाली हेलैत नहि छल; 25 मीटर लंबा पूल क कात मे प्रोफेशनल जेकां गोद निष्पादित क रहल छल।

ई तिकड़ी जापान म॑ अक्टूबर म॑ होबै वाला एशियाई पैरा गेम्स केरऽ पाँचमऽ संस्करण लेली प्रशिक्षण लै रहलऽ छेलै ।

नेपाल पारा तैराकी संघ के अध्यक्ष सरोज श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, हमरा सब लग चारि टा तैराक देश के प्रतिनिधित्व करबाक तैयारी मे छथि। “सृजना सरकी हमर सभक चारिम छथि, यद्यपि ओ आजुक सत्र मे छूटि गेल छलीह.”

दस्ता लगभग पांच महीना स॑ बौधा सुविधा म॑ प्रशिक्षण द॑ रहलऽ छै-एक ऐन्हऽ स्थान जेकरा बहुत हद तलक जरूरत के वजह स॑ चुनलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

श्रेष्ठ न॑ बतैलकै कि पैरा-एथलीट लेली सुलभ पूल खोजना असाधारण रूप स॑ कठिन छै । "सतडोबाटो केरऽ स्विमिंग कॉम्प्लेक्स बस बहुत दूर छै, जेकरा लेली हुनी नियमित रूप स॑ आबै-जाबै लेली बहुत दूर छै । हम्मं॑ ई केंद्र केरऽ गहराई स॑ आभारी छियै कि हुनी हमरा सब क॑ भारी छूट प॑ पूल केरऽ एक्सेस दै छै।"

सप्ताहांत क॑ छोड़ी क॑ हुनकऽ एक घंटा के प्रशिक्षण सत्र ठीक सुबह ७:३० बजे शुरू होय छै ।

एहि तैराक सभक लेल ओतय पहुँचब काफी अछि। जोरपतिके छात्रावासमे रहनिहार कदयात काठमाण्डू ट्रैफिकमे चलबाक लेल सहायक सहायक पहियासँ रिट्रोफिट कएल गेल स्कूटरसँ पहुँचैत छथि । कृत्रिम टांग ल' क' चलय बला घरती आ स्यांगबा पैदल पहुँचैत छथि, कारण आयोजन स्थल सं दस मिनटक पैदल दूरी पर रहैत छथि.

मुदा एहि पोखरि दिस हुनका लोकनिक यात्रा बहुत आगू शुरू भेलनि-आ एहन तरहें जे कियो अंदाजा नहि लगा सकैत छल.

ककरो आन’क लापरवाही स’ घायल

कदायत साईकिल स’ कैलाली’क गौरीगंगा नगरपालिका मे घर जा रहल छलीह, हुनकर मोन साधारण विचार मे बहैत छलनि. तखन एक स्प्लिट सेकेंड मे एकटा गाछ ओकरा पर खसि पड़लैक, जाहि सँ ओकर जीवन सदाक लेल बदलि गेलैक।

आब 26 साल क कदायत स्मरण करैत कहैत छथि, “ई 2 नवंबर 2013 क अछि।ई तारीख हुनकर याद मे खोदल अछि। "किछु लोक गाछ काटि रहल छल। राहगीर केँ सचेत करबाक लेल कोनो चेतावनी संकेत नहि छलैक, आ कियो ठाढ़ भ' क' लोक केँ रुक' लेल कहय लेल नहि छलैक। गाछ हमरा ऊपर खसि पड़ल। अगिला बात जे हमरा बुझल छल जे रीढ़क हड्डी मे चोट सँ हमर शरीरक निचला आधा भाग मे सब गतिविधि खतम भ' गेल छल।"

एक दू साल बाद अप्रैल 2015 के विनाशकारी भूकंप के समय के आसपास घरती के जीवन में एकटा आओर दुखद मोड़ आबि गेल.

बागलुंग के 21 वर्षीय मूल निवासी याद करैत कहैत छथि जे हम तहिया एखन बच्चा छलहुं। "हम सभ एकटा निर्माणाधीन जलविद्युत स्थल लग खेलाइत छलहुँ आ मवेशी झुंड बना लैत छलहुँ । एक दिन हम एकटा इन्सुलेटर पकड़ि लेलहुँ - जेकरा हम पहिने कतेको बेर छूबि लेने रही - बिना ई जनने जे बिजली चालू भ' गेल अछि । हमरा बहुत करंट लागि गेल छल । कोनो बाड़ि नहि छल , कोनो चेतावनी संकेत नहि छल , कोनो एहन चीज नहि छल जे हमरा सभ केँ दूर राखि सकैत छल ।"

दोसर दिस स्यांगबा रसुवा जिला मे नेपाल आ चीन क बीच केरुंग सीमा पार पर परिवहन क्षेत्र मे काज क रहल छलाह। साल 2017 के छल।

स्यांगबा साझा केलनि जे, हम सड़क के कात मे अपन ट्रक के बगल मे ठाढ़ छलहुं कि एकटा आओर ट्रक हमरा सं टकरा गेल। “हमर बामा टांग एतेक खराब कुचलल छल जे ठेहुन सँ नीचाँ काटि देबय पड़ल। दुर्घटना ठीक सीमा क्षेत्र मे भेलाक कारणे दुनू दिसक कोनो अधिकारी कहियो केस नहि केलक आ ने कानूनी प्रक्रिया शुरू केलक।”

बिना कोनो कानूनी जवाबदेही के तीनू मे सं कियो के अपन दुर्घटना के जिम्मेदार लोक सं मुआवजा नहि मिलल. नेपाल पारा तैराकी संघ के अध्यक्ष सरोज श्रेष्ठ चोट से ल क अभिजात प्रशिक्षण तक के यात्रा पूर्ण रूप स व्यक्तिगत सहनशक्ति स वहन भेल से नोट केलथि ।

सरोज कहलनि जे, तिकड़ी मे सं कियो अधिकारी सं कोनो तरहक आर्थिक सहयोग नहि भेटल आ ओ अपन इलाज के अपना दम पर कवर केलनि। "ओ सब अपन क्षमता गंवा देलक, मुदा एकटा पैघ लक्ष्य मे अपना कए समर्पित क लेलक अछि। हमरा सब कए खुशी अछि जे ओ सब एकटा खेल कए अपना लेलक आ अपन नाम बनेबाक फैसला केलक किया कि हुनका सब मे एखनो बहुत आगि अछि।"
